record.title: Define authoritative mentor assignments and access after reassignment

record.rationale: The operator accepted the concrete assignment/reassignment assumption. AFU subject IDs identify the settled assignment and history rules.

record.title: Set finite bounds for submitted files and message attachments
record.description: Accepted clarification sets finite file/message limits and no-side-effect outcomes for incomplete/out-of-limit uploads, and includes authorized storage with an operational owner.
record.conclusion: One submission file ≤25 MiB in PDF/DOCX/PPTX/JPEG/PNG; message ≤10,000 chars and at most one JPEG/PNG ≤10 MiB; invalid/incomplete input creates/replaces no submission version and sends no message; authorized storage with owner is in scope.
record.rationale: Human accepted the concrete input limits and authorized storage. Capacity/owner verification remains a Delivery prerequisite. AFU subject IDs capture the binding constraints and acceptance.

record.title: Restrict conversation access to the current mentor assignment
record.description: Work and the accepted assignment rule bound mentor visibility to the current assignment. Follow is a directory preference, not an assignment or permission.
record.conclusion: By evidence-backed deduction, new conversations may be initiated only with the currently assigned mentor; historical conversation visibility after reassignment follows the accepted assignment clarification. Follow grants no access.
record.rationale: Permitting unassigned mentors to receive a student's conversation would expose student identity/messages outside the assignment-scoped visibility boundary. This was resolved as an explicit deduction, not a human-origin rule.
